propositions: MCP agents cannot query whether a plan-review attestation is current without triggering a refusal error, forcing discovery of staleness only through failed claim or transition attempts
No read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` exists, creating a parity gap where CLI agents can call `rebar review-plan <id> --status` but MCP-only agents cannot
A new read-only MCP tool `plan_review_status` must delegate to the existing `rebar.llm.plan_review_status()` library function and return `PlanReviewStatusOut` with verdict and currency metadata
The tool must be registered only in the read-tool set (register_read_tools) and excluded from write-tool registrars, ensuring it operates under REBAR_MCP_READONLY mode
Implementation requires adding tool definition, output model, canonical JSON schema, and test coverage while maintaining McCabe complexity constraints in the registrar
